patch.objective: Admission control: validating and mutating webhooks, ValidatingAdmissionPolicy with CEL, Pod Security Admission and policy engines (Kyverno, OPA Gatekeeper)

sources.cite: CNCF KCSA Curriculum (cncf/curriculum, pinned commit 0a8cc08a): Overview of Cloud Native Security 14%, Kubernetes Cluster Component Security 22%, Kubernetes Security Fundamentals 22%, Kubernetes Threat Model 16%, Platform Security 16%, Compliance and Security Frameworks 10%
sources.note: The curriculum was read in primary text on 2026-11-07 by the course builder (backend/supabase/seed/tracks/kubernetes.ts). On 2026-11-17 a third-party summary (slauger.github.io/kubestronaut/kcsa/cluster-component-security) confirmed the 22% domain and its etcd topics (mutual TLS, access limited to the API server, encryption at rest, snapshots); the PDF itself was not re-read. The objective wording is the course seed's.

sources.cite: Kyverno documentation (release 1.13), Policy Reports: Background Scans
sources.note: Read through a summarizing fetch on 2026-11-17. Relevant text: background scans validate 'existing resources in the cluster that may have been created before a policy was created', for validate and verifyImages rules; they run periodically, by default every hour; violations go to a PolicyReport or ClusterPolicyReport; background scanning is on by default and spec.background: false turns it off; results are reported whether failureAction is Audit or Enforce, and a scan 'does not block any existing resources that match a rule, even in Enforce mode'. The validate rules page (release 1.18) could not be read on 2026-11-17 (the fetch was not approved in time): the admission denial's wording and the per-rule failureAction field are from memory of Kyverno's documentation (to verify).
